mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_model_pricing WHERE model_name = #{modelName} AND model_type = #{modelType} AND enabled = 1 AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) -- 优先精确供应商，其次允许同模型名的兼容价格（如 DeepSeek 走 OpenAI 兼容接口） ORDER BY CASE WHEN provider = #{provider} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, effective_from DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_model_pricing ORDER BY provider, model_name, effective_from DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_pricing (provider, model_name, model_type, input_price, output_price, cached_input_price, currency, version, effective_from, effective_to, enabled, demo_flag) VALUES (#{provider}, #{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{inputPrice}, #{outputPrice}, #{cachedInputPrice}, #{currency}, #{version}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{enabled}, #{demoFlag})
